description: Initial data dictionary for structuring historical evidence about Canal Barra.

nickname.description: Historical IRC nickname used as a pseudonymous public/community identifier.

fields.display_nick: Original visible nickname when safe to publish.
fields.known_variants: Optional list of known spelling/case variants.
fields.irc_syntax_valid: Boolean or null. Whether display_nick is syntactically compatible with an IRC nickname.
fields.irc_syntax_notes: Optional note explaining why a value is or is not IRC-syntax-valid. Invalid syntax may indicate a website display label, caption text, ornamental alias, OCR artifact or pending cleanup candidate.
fields.first_observed_year: First year in which the nickname is observed or documented.
fields.last_observed_year: Last year in which the nickname is observed or documented.
fields.civil_identity_linked: Boolean. Must be false in public datasets unless explicitly authorized and historically necessary.
fields.sensitive_data_included: Boolean. Must be false in public datasets.

ircontro.description: Dated physical gathering associated with Canal Barra.

fields.title: Event title.
fields.date: Event date in ISO format when known.
fields.attendance_estimated: Optional estimate; use null when unknown.

vip_list.description: Historical list documenting social recognition or event access.

fields.display_nick: Visible nickname when safe to publish.
fields.entry_type: guest, staff, vip, listed or unknown.
fields.attendance_confirmed: Boolean or null. A VIP entry alone should not imply attendance.

operator_history.description: Historical channel status, governance or access-level record.

fields.display_nick: Visible nickname when safe to publish.
fields.role: operator, founder, access_level_holder or other historically documented role.
fields.access_level: Numeric or symbolic access level when documented.
fields.period_start: Start date or year when known.
fields.period_end: End date or year when known.

source.description: Evidence item used to support a record.

fields.source_type: screenshot, website_page, book, academic_work, archive_url, oral_memory or other.
fields.title: Human-readable source title.
fields.file_path: Repository path when stored in the archive.
